title: Ordinary (I'm In Love With You)
style: warm acoustic indie-folk, fingerpicked nylon guitar, soft brushed drums, upright bass, gentle Wurlitzer, breathy male vocal, sunlit kitchen feel, 92 bpm, slight tape hiss, cozy, pastoral, hopeful
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Kettle on the bench like a little brass bell
Steam in the window writing letters I can't spell
Morning on the carpet, dust in a beam
Every ordinary thing is a quiet little dream

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, the day's still warm
Slow down, slow down, you outran the storm

[Chorus]
Ordinary, ordinary, beautiful and true
Ordinary morning and the sky is blue
Nothing's on fire, nothing's overdue
Ordinary, ordinary, I'm in love with you

[Verse 2]
Letters on the fridge in a child's careful hand
Footprints on the lino like a map of the land
Radio humming an old country tune
Spoon in the honey jar, the honey hits the spoon

[Pre-Chorus]
Slow down, slow down, the day's still warm
Slow down, slow down, you outran the storm

[Chorus]
Ordinary, ordinary, beautiful and true
Ordinary morning and the sky is blue
Nothing's on fire, nothing's overdue
Ordinary, ordinary, I'm in love with you

[Bridge]
Not every day has to be a brand-new world
Sometimes it's a bedsheet, a cup, a curl
A dog at the door and a hand on the latch
A song you don't finish, a stitch you don't catch

[Final Chorus]
Ordinary, ordinary, beautiful and true
Ordinary evening and the sky is blue
Nothing's on fire, nothing's overdue
Ordinary, ordinary, I'm in love with you
Ordinary, ordinary, I'm in love with you
